name: Lorem Ipsum Generator
summary: Generate classic placeholder copy by paragraph, sentence, or word — locally in your browser.
description: Create Lorem Ipsum filler text for mockups and layouts. Choose paragraphs, sentences, or words, optionally starting with the traditional “Lorem ipsum” opening.

faqs.question: Is the text random?
faqs.answer: It cycles a fixed classic Latin word list so output is deterministic and reproducible for a given count.

faqs.question: Can I generate up to 100 units?
faqs.answer: Yes. Count is clamped between 1 and 100.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
